verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing docs explicitly claim AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments and GL coding, which matches the story (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-8), but this is vendor-only messaging with no independent confirmation of an actual configurable approval-workflow feature. Community evidence raises broader concerns about trusting Brex's AI/automation reliability for financial data, adding uncertainty rather than confirming the workflow works as described.
